mapper.select: SELECT LMS_PRF_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT SEM_ID AS semId, SEM_YEAR AS semYear, SEM_TERM AS semTerm FROM SEMESTERS ORDER BY SEM_YEAR DESC, SEM_TERM DESC

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS lecName, lc.LEC_CODE AS lecCode, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, l.SEM_ID AS semId, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, l.LEC_VAL_STATUS AS lecValStatus FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId}
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) >= TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) AND l.SEM_ID = #{semId} ORDER BY l.SEM_ID DESC, lc.LEC_COD_NAME, l.LEC_ID

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS lecName, lc.LEC_CODE AS lecCode, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, l.SEM_ID AS semId, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, l.LEC_VAL_STATUS AS lecValStatus FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LEC_ID = #{lecId} AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT WHERE LEC_ID = #{lecId}

SELECT e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AS enrollmentId, m.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.MEMBER_NAME AS studentName, m.LOGIN_ID AS studentNo, (SELECT lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_ORG_URL FROM LMS_PROFILE_IMAGE lpi WHERE lpi.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID AND lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_VAL_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_REG_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS imageUrl, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE = 'PRS') AS presentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID) AS attendanceTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT asn ON asn.LEC_ASN_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_ID WHERE asn.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID AND sb.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID AND sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS != 'NSB') AS submittedCount, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE), 0) FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT asn ON asn.LEC_ASN_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_ID JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION ev ON ev.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID WHERE asn.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID AND sb.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID) AS averageScore FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE p ON p.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = p.MEMBER_ID WHERE e.LEC_ID = #{lecId} AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP'
AND ( m.MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{search}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR m.LOGIN_ID LIKE '%' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{search}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' ESCAPE '\' )
ORDER BY m.MEMBER_NAME, m.MEMBER_ID

SELECT m.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.MEMBER_NAME AS studentName, m.LOGIN_ID AS studentNo, (SELECT lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_ORG_URL FROM LMS_PROFILE_IMAGE lpi WHERE lpi.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID AND lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_VAL_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_REG_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS imageUrl, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS lectureName, e.LMS_PRF_ID AS studentLmsPrfId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE = 'PRS') AS attendancePresent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE = 'LAT') AS attendanceLate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE = 'ABS') AS attendanceAbsent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID) AS attendanceTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT asn ON asn.LEC_ASN_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_ID WHERE asn.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND sb.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID AND sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS != 'NSB') AS submittedCount, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE), 0) FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT asn ON asn.LEC_ASN_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_ID JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION ev ON ev.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID WHERE asn.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND sb.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID) AS averageScore FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE p ON p.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = p.MEMBER_ID WHERE e.LEC_ID = #{lecId} AND m.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId}

SELECT asn.LEC_ASN_ID AS assignmentId, asn.LEC_ASN_TITLE AS lecAsnTitle, sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS AS lecAsnSbmStatus, ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE AS asnSbmEvlScore FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT asn LEFT JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb ON sb.LEC_ASN_ID = asn.LEC_ASN_ID AND sb.LMS_PRF_ID = #{studentLmsPrfId} LEFT JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION ev ON ev.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID WHERE asn.LEC_ID = #{lecId} ORDER BY asn.LEC_ASN_REG_DATE
